title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Search Quality
description: P-1408 Sr. Staff Software Engineer (L7) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. As a Search Quality Engineer, you will build the contextual backbone that powers both AI agents and human users across the Databricks platform. You will own the quality of retrieval systems that enable LLMs to reason over data they weren't trained on, ensuring accurate, high-stakes business actions. This role sits at the intersection of traditional information retrieval and cutting-edge retrieval-augmented generation, solving search in its most evolved form. The Impact You Will Have - Own the design and implementation of hybrid retrieval systems that balance keyword-based search with semantic vector search to optimize both precision and intent understanding - Define and drive the technical strategy for search quality across the platform, ensuring high-recall, low-hallucination results for both AI agents and human users - Build evaluation frameworks and relevance scoring systems that measure and improve search quality through human-in-the-loop and LLM-based metrics - Lead cross-team initiatives to connect heterogeneous data sources, including structured tables, unstructured documents, and real-time business metrics - Establish technical standards and best practices for search and retrieval systems that influence engineering roadmaps across the organization - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for search quality and information retrieval across Databricks What We Look For - 10+ years of software engineering experience - Deep expertise in information retrieval systems, including experience with search engines, ranking algorithms, and relevance optimization - Strong understanding of hybrid retrieval architectures, semantic search, embeddings, and vector databases - Experience building and operating evaluation frameworks for search quality, with expertise in relevance metrics including nDCG, MRR, and Precision@K - Track record of leading complex technical projects that span multiple teams or system boundaries, with demonstrated ability to influence technical direction at the organizational level - Experience applying traditional information retrieval techniques to modern AI systems, including retrieval-augmented generation - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs and drive alignment across engineering and product teams - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
